about_the_game:
You are an egg.  You, oh no, you were happy in your nest, but you just got blown out in a storm.  Can you find your way back up?

  • Simple controls: just roll and jump!
  • A single rainy world: explore one continuous landscape as you find your way back. 
  • 3D physics-based movement: Roll, jump, and slide around just like a real egg! 
  • Calm, rainy atmosphere: No enemies, no timers; you can take your time and soak up the atmosphere.
  • A medium-sized adventure: 5-10 hours playtime for a new player.
  • Challenging moments: the game balances gentle bopping about with more challenging segments.  Be prepared to sweat as you line up that final jump before the next checkpoint.
  • Original soundtrack: chill for the most part : )
  • Level editor (needs keyboard+mouse).
  • Explore co-op with your friends online!

Roll home, little egg! <3

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2018
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 support, x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, with 4 physical cores or more
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
